subject: Which OTs in your team should see this in person?
preheader: A practical Forté session for clinicians building confidence in mattress selection.
intro: When an OT is developing confidence around pressure care and mattress prescription, seeing static, hybrid and powered surfaces together is far more useful than comparing specifications on a screen.
On 21 October, Sleep Choice and Forté Healthcare are running a practical session in Brighton East for OTs who would benefit from a stronger working understanding of clinical mattress selection.
sectionTitle: Who in your team would benefit most?
body: You are very welcome to join us, but I would particularly value you sharing this with the clinicians in your team who are beginning to work with pressure care, mattresses or more complex home-based clients.

Craig Gorman will cover pressure-care fundamentals, pressure-injury prevention and how static, hybrid and powered support surfaces apply in everyday clinical practice, with real-world examples, discussion and Q&A.

Forté is the clinical mattress range we are most excited to work with and stand behind. Through Sleep Choice, OTs can then arrange flexible seven-night home trials across the range to assess comfort, positioning, transfers, usability and overall suitability before finalising a recommendation.
eventTitle: Attend yourself or nominate a colleague
